lütt.et:
Borrowed from German Low German lütt, from Middle Low German lüttek, from Old Saxon luttik, from Proto-West Germanic *lūtil.
Cognate with archaic German lützel, English little, Dutch luttel, Danish lille, Swedish/Norwegian liten. More at little.

lützel.et: From Middle High German lüzzel, lützel, from Old High German luzil, luzzil, liuzil, from Proto-Germanic *luttilaz, byform of *lūtilaz. Cognate with English little and Low German lütt.
